iconicAnchor.label: USGS topographic map symbol system
iconicAnchor.creatorOrTradition: United States Geological Survey cartographic practice
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: USGS explains how points, lines, areas, colors, and a legend encode buildings, terrain, water, vegetation, roads, and other mapped features.

sources.title: Topographic Map Symbols
supports: Topographic maps use coordinated point, line, area, color, and legend systems to represent terrain and geographic features.

sources.title: Help Guide: How to Read These Maps
supports: Contour lines join equal elevations and reveal height, depth, and slope while other symbols encode roads, water, boundaries, vegetation, and structures.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent lead with distinct support.
